The '''Nexus Ortai system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Hertae sector/Legends|Hertae sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nexus Ortai/Legends|Nexus Ortai]].
